orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until a lot is edited in the admin UI. daily_order_capacity is the UI's "Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity", not an all-order ceiling. A null means the field is not configured, which is not the same as a ceiling of 0.
